, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly updated the understanding to say that the 1949 Liberal–Country Coalition election victory caused Robert Menzies (founder of the Liberal Party) to become Prime Minister. The question targets the event that first made him PM, which was Joseph Lyons’ death in April 1939. This misinterpretation led toward the wrong solution.
